column1: %1$s becomes the date and time of the save, %2$s the video's number on Facebook, %3$s who posted it and %4$s the day it was posted. What a save doesn't know is left out, and a name with none of these gets the date added. When the name is already in the folder, the time of the save goes on the end. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to use the default, %5$s.

Caracteres inválidos viram sublinhados. Deixe em branco para usar o nome padrão, %5$s.

column1: # context: text of that note; Android's own settings are the phone's per-app notification categories, which Facebook's server defines

Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions, calls and login alerts, and any kind Hushfacebook doesn't know. Android's own settings for Facebook's notification categories work too, since Facebook drops a notification whose category you turned off. As configurações do próprio Android para as categorias de notificação do Facebook também funcionam, porque o Facebook descarta uma notificação cuja categoria você desativou. Mas é o servidor do Facebook que decide quais categorias você recebe, então elas podem não separar esses tipos.
